candidates.name: Jebel Dhanna-Fujairah Oil Pipeline

evidence.note: MEED project-intelligence brief: ADNOC close to awarding a contract for a pipeline to transport crude oil from Jebel Dhanna in Abu Dhabi to its oil terminal in Fujairah; contractor/length/diameter/capacity behind paywall.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Not on roster under this route. Roster has Habshan-Jebel Dhanna (P0639/P7214/P7215/P7216, feeding Jebel Dhanna for tanker loading) and Bab-Habshan-Fujairah/ADCOP (P0553, Habshan origin), but no Jebel Dhanna-to-Fujairah overland segment. Likely the same underlying project publicly announced 2026-05-15 as ADNOC's 'West-East 1' pipeline (already flagged separately as a leads2026 candidate, consistently described elsewhere as Habshan-origin, parallel to ADCOP) - this Jan-2024 industry brief may be an earlier/more specific description of that same contract-award phase (CPECC was awarded onshore West-East sections in 2024, matching this timing) rather than a wholly separate line. Flagging so the consolidator can merge it with the West-East 1 candidate or confirm it as a distinct Jebel Dhanna-origin segment - could not find independent corroboration of the Jebel Dhanna start point beyond this single paywalled source, so treat as weak/borderline until reconciled.
